About

Photography rooted
in Kerry

KHD Photography is based in Killarney, with weddings and shoots across Dublin and the whole of Ireland. From the lakes and mountains of Killarney National Park to candlelit manor houses, the work is about one thing: real moments, beautifully kept.

Weddings, fashion shoots, events and portraits — photographed with a calm, unobtrusive approach, so the day stays yours and the photographs stay honest.

Services

What I photograph

Weddings

Full-day coverage from morning preparations to the first dance. Killarney, Dublin and destination weddings across Ireland.

Fashion

Editorial and lookbook shoots on location — the Kerry landscape makes a backdrop no studio can match.

Events

Corporate events, family celebrations and everything in between, captured naturally.

Portraits & model portfolios

Individual sessions and portfolio building for models — relaxed, well-lit, and directed when you need it.
